concepts.name: Control token and context cost
concepts.description: Track token usage, trim irrelevant history, summarize, compress, set response limits, and prune context.

concepts.name: Route by cost and capability
concepts.description: Choose the least expensive model that meets quality and safety requirements, with escalation for harder tasks.

concepts.name: Optimize capacity and batching
concepts.description: Use batching, concurrency controls, capacity planning, and Provisioned Throughput when utilization patterns justify them.

concepts.name: Use caching effectively
concepts.description: Cache repeated prompts, semantic results, deterministic outputs, or edge responses when freshness and privacy allow it.

concepts.name: Optimize end-to-end latency
concepts.description: Profile each stage and use streaming, parallelization, precomputation, latency-optimized inference, or smaller models where appropriate.

concepts.name: Optimize retrieval performance
concepts.description: Tune indexes, chunking, filters, hybrid retrieval, top-k, and reranking while measuring relevance and latency together.

concepts.name: Tune throughput and concurrency
concepts.description: Use request batching, concurrency limits, autoscaling, and backpressure appropriate to the serving architecture.

concepts.name: Tune inference parameters
concepts.description: Adjust temperature, top-p, top-k, max tokens, and model-specific parameters to trade off determinism, diversity, latency, and cost.

concepts.name: Plan and scale serving capacity
concepts.description: Match autoscaling, endpoint type, accelerators, and provisioned model capacity to observed demand and SLOs.

concepts.name: Profile APIs, vector stores, and network paths
concepts.description: Use traces and metrics to find whether latency comes from model invocation, retrieval, tools, network, or application code.

concepts.name: Define holistic GenAI observability
concepts.description: Track operational health, performance traces, FM interactions, and business impact in a coherent observability model.

concepts.name: Monitor GenAI-specific KPIs
concepts.description: Track token usage, prompt effectiveness, hallucination/quality indicators, invocation logs, drift, benchmarks, and cost anomalies.

concepts.name: Integrate operational, business, compliance, and forensic views
concepts.description: Create dashboards and traces that connect system metrics with business impact, compliance evidence, user interactions, and model behavior patterns.

concepts.name: Observe tool and multi-agent performance
concepts.description: Track tool-call patterns, latency, error rates, utilization, baselines, and multi-agent coordination so agent extensions remain reliable.

concepts.name: Monitor vector-store operations
concepts.description: Watch query performance, index health, ingestion/synchronization, data quality, and optimization needs for vector retrieval systems.

concepts.name: Detect GenAI-specific failure modes
concepts.description: Use golden datasets, output diffs, reasoning/tool traces, and specialized quality pipelines to detect hallucinations, consistency regressions, and logical errors.
